title: SessionRoute
description: GET /v1/session-route?session=<id> — the account currently serving one client session, and its recent account switches. Auth: inference API key (Bearer). 'session' is required and is the canonical session id the router derives from the client's headers: 'claude:<X-Claude-Code-Session-Id>', 'codex:<session_id>', 'affinity:<X-Opencode-Session>'; only an exact match resolves. Account labels carry the same exposure as GET /v1/quota (masked name, provider, type, plan), never tokens, emails or auth ids. Data is in-process history fed by the usage record bus, so reading it consumes nothing and makes no upstream calls; a client UI can poll it. Only generating requests count; a failed request alone never names a serving account. Retention: at most 4096 sessions, 8 switches each (newest kept), and a session idle for an hour expires. Status codes: 200 (this schema), 400 no session given, 401 bad key, 404 session never served or expired. Errors are {"error": string} (see $defs/error). Compatibility: additive-only under /v1 — new optional fields may appear, existing fields never change type or meaning; clients MUST ignore unknown properties and tolerate unknown reason values.

session.description: Canonical session id that was looked up.

account.description: Account serving the session's newest request.

model.description: Upstream model of the session's newest request.

since.description: When the current account first served the session.

last_seen.description: Start of the session's newest successful request.

switches.description: Recent account switches, oldest first, at most 8. Always an array.

name.description: Masked account label, as in /v1/quota. Absent once the account was removed from the proxy.

plan.description: Plan label when known; vocabulary not guaranteed.

in_cooldown.description: Whether the account is blocked right now.

at.description: Start of the first request the new account served.

reason.description: 'quota' (429 in this session, or the account is quota-exceeded), 'cooldown' (the account is cooling down), 'error' (another failure in this session), 'rebind' (no cause observed: affinity expiry, rebind policy, or no affinity). Clients MUST tolerate other values.

status_code.description: Upstream status behind the switch, when one was observed in this session.
